title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Canonical sources, evidence-preserving bundles, standalone discoveries and reader-facing web-discovery records are counted separately. Raw WEB-MUN audit records are preserved even when later records are deterministically reconciled as duplicates.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count volume slots with a verified external locator that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

source_registers.id_policy: new standalone discoveries receive immutable SRC-MMSC identifiers after duplicate checking

source_registers.counting_rule: The layer contains 90 immutable WEB-MUN audit records. WEB-MUN-0088 duplicates WEB-MUN-0032 by exact canonical URL; WEB-MUN-0089 duplicates permanent SRC-MMSC-000002 by exact DOI/title/author/year; and WEB-MUN-0090 duplicates permanent SRC-MMSC-000012 by exact DOI/title/author/year and ACL Anthology identity. These reconciliations yield 87 unique web leads. Thirteen unique leads are counted once through standalone SRC-MMSC identities; 74 unique leads remain outside the audited identity total.

metrics.note: Audited source identities remain 41. The web layer preserves 90 raw records but contains 87 unique leads after three deterministic duplicate reconciliations. Thirteen unique leads are canonicalized into audited identities; 74 unique leads remain outside. WEB-MUN-0090 is the same MunTTS paper already represented by SRC-MMSC-000012 and is retained only as an immutable later audit observation. No source-completeness, permission or cultural-validation claim is implied.
